data: What does the token <S> represent in the word lattice?

The token <S> represents the start of the sentence in the word lattice. It is placed at the beginning of the sequence of words, indicating the beginning of the text. The token </S> represents the end of the sentence, which is placed at the end of the sequence. These tokens are used to mark the boundaries of the sentence in the word lattice.
